metadata.description: Ultimate one-stop design intelligence for AI coding agents — interfaces + visual/marketing collateral — as a skill, subagents, and commands backed by a deep, progressive-disclosure knowledge base.

plugins.name: ui-ux-design-pro
plugins.description: World-class, one-stop design intelligence. A ui-ux-pro skill that auto-activates on any design work, plus commands (/ui-build, /ui-review, /design-system, /make-deck, /make-carousel, /make-creative) and ui-designer / frontend-implementer / visual-designer / design-reviewer subagents — backed by ~35 dense reference files spanning two tracks: interfaces (principles, foundations, components, motion, a11y, page patterns, modern React+Tailwind+shadcn stack) and visual/marketing design (presentations, social carousels & posts, ads, posters, print, email, brand systems, and an HTML→PNG/PDF/PPTX/MP4 production pipeline).
